site_metrics.community_survival_fraction: number of distinct canonical worlds surviving the guild-positive node set divided by distinct canonical world count
site_metrics.species_survival_fraction: same quantity for each frozen target species; species with fewer than 2 retained positive nodes have survival fraction 0
site_metrics.max_species_survival_fraction: maximum species survival fraction across all frozen target taxa
site_metrics.strict_emergent_world_fraction: distinct canonical worlds where the guild survives and zero frozen target species survive, divided by distinct canonical world count
site_metrics.dominance_coverage: maximum retained positive-node count of any target species divided by guild-positive node count

cross_species_rescue.denominator: all guild-positive target-node x canonical-world pairs for worlds in which the guild survives
cross_species_rescue.numerator: pairs where the target has at least one adjacent guild-positive peer but no adjacent guild-positive peer sharing any target species with the target node

permutation_null.seed_rule: integer represented by first 8 hex digits of sha256('neon_metacommunity_connectivity_v1|'+site_code)
permutation_null.permutation: permute complete nonempty species-incidence row vectors among the fixed guild-positive node coordinates within each site
permutation_null.community_survival_fraction: held fixed because the guild-positive node set is unchanged

aggregate_primary.site_sign: positive if null_adjusted_effect > 0; negative if < 0; tie if exactly 0
aggregate_primary.ties: excluded from the exact sign-test denominator and reported separately
aggregate_primary.test: one-sided exact binomial sign test with H0 probability positive = 0.5

secondary_associations.statistic: Spearman rank correlation across scored sites
secondary_associations.role: mechanistic secondary; cannot rescue failed primary

forbidden: switch from max species to mean species after response
change the null permutation unit after response
change 999 replicates or the seed rule after response
drop scored sites based on effect direction
promote secondary correlations to primary after response
